notes: JD Frag Engine 6.1: the taskbar now shows JD Frag Engine with the JD logo (not the MSI icon). From 6.0: JD-Optimiers now has its new name everywhere (window, tray, pop-ups, console, file properties, sign-in page). Nothing to redo: your sign-in, settings and history carry on.
